notes.note: #0.2-15 (2-9 in story_105) is a 14-slot leader block answering Ankh's question whether the other Gaia Gates are on this floor; #0.10-15 identical Japanese -> identical English, subject 'we' restored.
Ankh senses an unfamiliar Greeed (the coming Shocker Greeed); 'Kazari and the others' = the known Greeed.
Source punctuates with '!?'; kept as a taunting '!?'.
#0.2-16: 15-slot leader block; #0.5 rough variant uses the squid insult (precedent 'You squid bastard!!'), likely Momotaros/Zero.
'Gaia Impact' (Kamen Rider W term) not in glossary; used the established franchise name.
Sentence runs into #0.21 ('Its name: Shocker Greeed!!'); cut at the same point with a trailing ellipsis.
Shocker Greeed's battle cry (the word 'Shocker' drawn out) rendered as elongated 'Shooockeeeer!!', in line with the 'Long live Shockeeeeer!!' precedent; #0.27 is its death cry.
Ikadevil's self-reference 'washi' carried through tone; 'kochira ni wa' rendered 'on our side'. Number of unknown Medals unknown; singular kept to match Ankh's follow-up.
Threat trails off in the source after 'the likes of you'; kept unfinished.
Name variable + padding -> tag only; 'tachi' rendered 'and the team' per brief precedent.

#0.39-52: 14-slot leader block, chain order not resolved, voiced by wording. #0.40 'yatta na' read as 'We did it' (the Shocker Greeed win), though Ankh just lost the Medal and Ikadevil. #0.41 'sumanai' read as thanks, not apology (cf. #0.44 'arigatou'). #0.51-52 curt 'ryoukai shita' (likely Heero/Setsuna).
Ankh echoes Shotaro with a questioning '!?'.
Bracketed term in double quotes per brief.

#0.12-26: 15-slot leader block, voiced by wording (Terror's fear effect). #0.13 'mata ka' = 'Not again', archaic 'ugokan' (older voice). #0.14 and #0.21-26 identical Japanese -> identical English; #0.18-19 lack the exclamations and are kept flat.
Subject of 'dou surya ii' unstated; 'we' chosen since Ankh speaks for the paralysed party.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader blocks (0582 #0.10-15 tail, 0586 #0.2-16, #0.39-52, 0587 #0.12-26) voiced by wording; chain order not resolved. Uncertain: 0586 #0.40 'yatta na' read as 'We did it'; #0.41 'sumanai' read as thanks. Not in glossary: 'Gaia Impact' (W franchise term), 'Shocker Medal' (Ankh's ad-hoc name, literal).
